Пожалуйста, попробуйте отправить MMS-сообщение и сообщите мне, удалось ли это сделать. Если проблема всё ещё сохраняется, мы продолжим диагностику других настроек."

The final state: signal excellent, network 5G, data enabled. According to policy, for MMS to work, need cellular service and mobile data (any speed). Also need correct APN settings (MMSC URL). The agent hasn't checked APN settings or MMSC URL. The policy says: For MMS troubleshooting, after ensuring basic connectivity, need to verify APN (MMSC URL). If check_apn_settings shows MMSC URL not set, guide user to reset_apn_settings and reboot_device. The agent didn't do that. However, the user hasn't reported that MMS still fails; they asked if they should try sending MMS. The agent responded encouraging them to try. Is that an error? The policy says we must try all possible ways to resolve before transferring. But we haven't verified APN settings.
